lyoo_intro_1.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_intro_1.text: To use your ability, press SPACE. Each character has a unique ability and there will be a "Bonus Input" you can perform to make your ability more effective.

lyoo_intro_2.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_intro_2.text: For example, Miku's "Bonus Input" is a small rythm game, the more accurate you press, the more damage she will deal!

miku_intro_1.speaker: Miku
miku_intro_1.text: I don't need someone to tell me what I can or can't do.

lyoo_intro_3.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_intro_3.text: Then go ahead and try clanker

miku_intro_2.speaker: Miku
miku_intro_2.text: WHAT DID YOU JUST CALL ME-

lyoo_cupcakke_intro.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_cupcakke_intro.text: Now try {character}'s {skill_name}. Different input, same idea. {skill_description} Input: {skill_input} Keep it alive and don't make me explain this twice.

lyoo_ultimate_intro.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_ultimate_intro.text: When an ultimate is ready, do not panic and do not freestyle. Look at the glowing circle, read the callout, and cast it on command.

lyoo_ultimate_ready.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_ultimate_ready.text: Those are your "Ultimate Points". {character} is full, so press {manual_ultimate_hotkey} to queue {ultimate_name}. And since you clearly need guardrails, that's the only button I'm letting you touch right now.

lyoo_boss_intro.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_boss_intro.text: And before you ask, yes, bosses have gimmicks too. Mine is {boss_skill_name}. {boss_skill_description} Input: {boss_input} Read the warning, answer it properly, and try not to flop.

lyoo_miku_retry.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_miku_retry.text: Nope. That was not clean enough. Your damage is gone, your turn is back, and you're doing it again. Watch the lane and land the notes properly this time.

lyoo_cupcakke_retry.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_cupcakke_retry.text: You dropped the input. Run {skill_name} again and keep the sequence alive this time.

lyoo_boss_retry.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_boss_retry.text: That was not the counter. I'm doing the attack again, so pay attention this time.

lyoo_outro.speaker: Lyoo
lyoo_outro.text: Now, let's see if you're worthy of participating in the BIT Underground Idol Competition~

coach_unlock_intro.speaker: Training Console
coach_unlock_intro.text: {character} just joined your roster. Run the onboarding drill now: learn the kit, clear the checks, and finish the field test before story resumes.

coach_skill_retry.speaker: Training Console
coach_skill_retry.text: Requirement not met. Re-run {skill_name} and clear the input check before the drill advances.

coach_shifted_skill_intro.speaker: Training Console
coach_shifted_skill_intro.text: Kit shift detected. {ultimate_name} changed the move list. New skill check: {skill_name}. {skill_description} Input: {skill_input}

coach_boss_intro.speaker: Training Console
coach_boss_intro.text: Boss preview: {boss_skill_name}. {boss_skill_description} Input: {boss_input} Clear the mechanic here before the live encounter starts.

coach_boss_retry.speaker: Training Console
coach_boss_retry.text: Boss preview requirement failed. Run the boss mechanic again and hit the minimum performance threshold.

coach_boss_complete.speaker: Training Console
coach_boss_complete.text: Boss preview complete. Mechanic registered. Launching the live encounter.

coach_complete.speaker: Training Console
coach_complete.text: Drill complete. {character} is registered and ready for live deployment. Story flow can resume.
